propositions: Close transition must fail deterministically before LLM verifier dispatch if the ticket's Acceptance Criteria section contains unchecked '- [ ]' items that lack the [operator-attested] tag.
The [operator-attested] tag (case-insensitive) on an unchecked checkbox line exempts that item from the precheck violation using the shared regex matcher from det_operator_attested.py.
Close paths for non-completion classes (duplicate, not_a_bug, escalated) bypass the AC checkbox precheck unchanged.
Tickets with prose-only Acceptance Criteria (no checkbox syntax) pass the precheck without violation.
Failed precheck provides teaching message guiding users to check the box or edit the AC with justification.
All historical verifier-passed closes, including those with attested-shaped unchecked items, remain passing under the new precheck logic.
